reconstruction_strategy: Clean-Room WebRTC Implementation with REA-driven Protocol Parity, High-Scale Architecture & Host Controls

obligations.title: Room Creation, Validation & Peer Join Flow
obligations.target_behavior: Client requests room access with room ID (e.g. xxx-yyyy-zzz), signaling server tracks room participants, emits peer joined events, and maintains participant directory.
obligations.evidence: server/index.js: join-room event with room Map state and member broadcast

obligations.title: SDP Offer / Answer & ICE Candidate Relay
obligations.target_behavior: WebRTC session negotiation via WebSocket/Socket.io relay exchanging JSEP SDP descriptions and STUN ICE candidates between peers.
obligations.evidence: server/index.js: offer, answer, ice-candidate socket handlers

obligations.title: Host-Broadcast Star Topology & Virtualized Host Viewport (Webinar Privacy Mode)
obligations.target_behavior: Eliminates O(N^2) mesh scaling bottlenecks without an external SFU by enforcing a Host-Broadcast Star Topology. Non-host participants establish exactly 1 WebRTC connection (directly to the host) and are privacy-blinded from other participants. The host client uses paginated viewport virtualization (6 tiles per page) + active speaker + pinned peer, ensuring low client-side CPU/bandwidth.
obligations.evidence: client/src/hooks/useWebRTC.js (star-topology peer filtering), server/index.js (room-snapshot privacy filtering & targeted host-only deltas), verified via test-fixes.js

obligations.title: Voice Activity Detection (VAD) & Active Speaker Spotlight
obligations.target_behavior: Client-side Web Audio API AnalyserNode computes RMS vocal levels; server tracks activeSpeakers set and broadcasts dynamic spotlight promotion.

obligations.title: Batched Delta Broadcasting & Event Loop Protection
obligations.target_behavior: Prevents event-loop starvation by buffering room state changes into 50ms interval ticks, broadcasting compact delta arrays.

obligations.title: Multi-Worker CPU Clustering with Sticky Routing & Cluster Adapter
obligations.target_behavior: Utilizes Node.js cluster module with @socket.io/sticky HTTP routing and @socket.io/cluster-adapter IPC signaling across CPU cores to balance WebSocket connections without in-memory state collisions.
obligations.evidence: server/cluster.js (@socket.io/sticky primary/worker setup) & server/index.js (createAdapter cluster sync)

obligations.title: Host Role Assignment, Waiting Room Failover & Roster Sync
obligations.target_behavior: First participant is assigned host authority. On host disconnect, server elects successor from admitted peers or promotes first waiting participant to prevent meeting stranding, transferring waiting list and broadcasting synchronized host-changed deltas.
obligations.evidence: server/index.js (disconnect failover, waitingList succession, peer-media-toggle delta), verified via test-fixes.js

obligations.title: Meeting Lock, Participant Removal, and Global Mute
obligations.target_behavior: Host can lock room preventing new joins, force-mute all participants, or kick abusive participants with server disconnection.
obligations.evidence: server/index.js (host-mute-all, host-kick-peer, lock enforcement in join-room)

obligations.title: Policy Enforcement (Screen Sharing, Chat & Audio/Video Locking)
obligations.target_behavior: Host toggles room-wide policies; client controls disable mic, camera, screen share, and chat inputs with tooltip warnings for non-hosts.

obligations.title: Hardware Device Enumeration & Speaker Test
obligations.target_behavior: Enumerate system audio inputs, audio outputs, and video cameras with live speaker tone synthesizer test.

obligations.title: Dynamic Resolution & Bandwidth Controls
obligations.target_behavior: User selects send resolution (720p / 360p / 180p) and receive resolution (auto / audio-only) to throttle bandwidth on slow networks.

obligations.title: MediaStream Acquisition & Device Permissions
obligations.target_behavior: Acquire user audio and video tracks via navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia with fallback handling for permission denial.
obligations.evidence: client/src/hooks/useWebRTC.js: getMediaStream with echoCancellation and noiseSuppression

obligations.title: STUN NAT Traversal & Multi-Peer Connection Mesh
obligations.target_behavior: Configures Google's public STUN server (stun.l.google.com:19302) to establish direct P2P audio/video media streams across NATs.

obligations.title: Mute/Unmute & Camera Track Toggle
obligations.target_behavior: Client enables/disables MediaStreamTrack without renegotiating the peer connection; notifies other peers to update their UI indicator.

obligations.title: Screen Sharing Integration
obligations.target_behavior: Acquires screen track via navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia and replaces video sender tracks in RTCPeerConnection.

obligations.title: Google Meet Dark Theme & Control Bar
obligations.target_behavior: Authentic bottom pill controls (mic, camera, screen, raise hand, chat, participants, telemetry HUD, settings gear, leave call button).

obligations.title: Dual-Layout Video Grid & Pinned Stream Persistence
obligations.target_behavior: Dynamic dual-layout rendering: Host sees 6-tile-per-page grid with synchronized WebRTC subscriptions and spotlight/pinned peer retention; non-hosts see a privacy-focused Host + Self stage with zero visibility into other participants.

obligations.title: Pre-Join Lobby (Green Room)
obligations.target_behavior: User checks camera preview, tests mic/camera toggle, sets display name, and enters or generates room code before joining.

obligations.title: Raise Hand & Searchable Roster Panel
obligations.target_behavior: Instant search bar across 500+ people, categorized into Speakers vs Audience with priority sorting for raised hands and host quick actions.

obligations.title: Scalability Telemetry & Bandwidth Conservation HUD
obligations.target_behavior: Floating live HUD showing total participants, active streams decoded, bandwidth/CPU saved percentage, and active speaker.

obligations.title: Unified Settings Modal with Authority Gating
obligations.target_behavior: Tabbed dialog (Audio, Video, General, Host controls) dynamically revealing meeting management or restriction state based on user authority.

obligations.title: In-Meeting Realtime Chat with Host Lock
obligations.target_behavior: Slide-out panel for real-time chat with host badge and automated lock state when host disables in-call messaging.
